name: Croatia
headline: Croatia: +3.4% growth in 2025, 4.4% inflation, debt 56% of GDP
sections: Croatia is a $105 billion economy (2025), the world's 75th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +3.4% in 2025, close to the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $51K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 10.1% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 4.4% in 2025, above typical targets, down from 10.7% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 4.5% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 16.5% (2025).
Gross government debt is 56% of GDP (2025), a moderate level that has fallen from 87% in 2020. The general government balance is −3.0% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is −3.5% of GDP (2025). Trade equals 101% of GDP (2025), a highly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 2.8% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 58% of GDP by 2031, broadly stable from today's level. Life expectancy is 78.9 years (2024). Population: 3.9 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
